verdict.label: benign
verdict.description: Package contains only metadata with no executable scripts or hooks.

behaviors.behavior: No install hook or lifecycle script present in package.json
behaviors.analysis: The package.json file contains only 'name' and 'version' fields. No 'scripts', 'bin', or 'main' entry points are defined that could execute code during installation.
behaviors.impact: No malicious payload execution possible via standard npm lifecycle hooks.

remediation: Verify package integrity using checksums before deployment.
Ensure no external dependencies are added post-installation.

decision.label: benign
reasons: Install path not fully reviewed; human review required
